# Halavanau Law Office, P.C.

> > California personal injury and tenant rights law firm serving San Francisco Bay Area communities with specialized expertise in vehicle accidents, wrongful death, and housing law.

Halavanau Law Office, P.C., led by attorney Gene Halavanau, represents victims of traffic accidents including pedestrian, bicycle, rideshare, and truck collisions throughout the Bay Area. The firm also provides comprehensive tenant rights advocacy across California.

## Key Topics

- Personal injury law
- Wrongful death claims
- Pedestrian accidents
- Hit-and-run accidents
- Truck accidents
- Rideshare (Uber/Lyft) accidents
- Bicycle accidents
- Tenant rights
- California law
- San Francisco Bay Area
- Traffic collisions
- Accident compensation
- Undocumented immigrant rights
- Fault determination
- California Highway Patrol
